text: Baseline b217da7ec18cf7fe3e3869ea1538fcf41bf1032a, rules revision 5, AGENTS.md, docs/steering/rules.md, docs/steering/router.md, solver-quests.md, runtime-contracts.md, authority-and-recovery.md, testing regression policy. This bounded successor follows terminal repository-legacy-fallback-closure. Its seal, receipts, inventory counts and past failed-create cleanup-claim-normalization remain historical. The latter separates cleanup claim availability from ordinary settlement and does not grant permission when target lifecycle is unavailable.

ReplicaOperationRepository.getActualReplicaObservation reads the exact authoritative SERVICES target using operation replicaId, partitionId and targetNodeId. It distinguishes OBSERVED lifecycle, corroborated ABSENT, and UNAVAILABLE. OperationWorkflowOwner.failOperation consumes admission via admitCreateTerminalFailure/revalidateCreateTerminalFailure. ADD admission currently maps every non-live answer including UNAVAILABLE to admitted. Use the repository-owned state. Preserve the existing durable replica_operations step CAS, revalidate before mutation, and retain the active row and storage reservation on refusal. An observed live target completes, and confirmed absence or observed non-live status can admit ordinary failure. Exact-generation failed-create cleanup claim remains a separate decision. Existing timeout/recovery triggers can redrive the same operation when evidence returns. Retained repair must distinguish a fresh write from replay of a proven durable winner. No new timers or stores.

Priority recovery superseded assessment consumes getObservedReplicaStatusFromCache for existing pre-sync materialization evidence. Missing canonical collaborator is a composition defect and must not be interpreted as an empty projection. A present collaborator still owns status and null semantics. Existing cached materialization and absent-target positive controls remain. Test scopes: the strict-operation-outcomes coordinator/repository harness uses production SQLite schemas and mutation planner, with exact SERVICES authority failure isolated at its read seam; stale-priority coordinator drives the existing required cache observation dependency. Parent integration owns managed RED/GREEN, candidate review, and final Quest evidence.

Integration authorized migrating the superseded-target decision to the repository-owned exact authoritative observation. A real cache miss can hide a materialized target, so requiring the old cache accessor would preserve the same false failure. Both asynchronous remove-safety callers and the priority recovery wrapper must await the decision. Keep its operation/partition/target identity and shared decision semantics, with explicit unavailability delaying target supersession. Extend the managed witness in strict-operation-outcomes.test.js: exact durable CREATING row hidden from cache, unavailable authoritative query, and genuine exact absence. Terminal repair must re-enter guarded admission for an uncommitted ADD write while releasing a known durable winner even through SERVICES unavailability.

The same false negative is reachable in recovery-drain: resolvePriorityRecoveryRemoteSupersededTargetDrainError consumes the cache-derived target classification under RECOVERY_ELIGIBLE_EXCLUDED, and pre-sync replace drain uses it to infer stale unmaterialized failure. Scope includes both snapshot consumers (buildPriorityRecoveryOperationDrainSnapshot and buildPriorityRecoveryDispatchPendingDrainSnapshot) and the source-drain evidence chain. These belong to the same exact-target owner interaction. The common witness binds unavailable, confirmed absence and an authoritative materialized target through dispatch supersession, remote drain supersession and stale target classification.

Managed baseline RED on 2ac73d1b48d37a6379074dc7570e75058e62252c, adam-laptop, 561 assertions, no retry. First failure: "failure is refused without exact lifecycle". The ADD initial failure, retained uncommitted FAILED repair, local/remote priority supersession and stale pre-sync decisions all fail their refusal assertions. The already-durable FAILED repair releases as expected. Managed output 2ac73d1b48d3-mwpgnyxx-3433057-adam-laptop.log SHA-256 7f52e6e1a442be73a65022dbbb3226c9c3ec1a2227129b46dd6c89fdbdd0313c; integration custody /tmp/lagrange-takeover-20261120/observation-authority-red.

The stale fallback in resolvePriorityRecoveryOperationDrainStepStaleState can independently turn a generic unavailable-source state into stale failure after a CONVERGED timeout. Map target unavailability distinctly and retain the operation in that arm, while preserving a positively dead target under the existing independent failure-detector owner. Canonical states migrate with the repository producer, and available observation requires an actual known lifecycle when OBSERVED. Preserve stop/retire consumers via the same enum.

Integration assigned the coupled dispatch result consumer. OperationWorkflowOwner.executeOperationInternal and _handleDispatchResponse currently await failOperation but construct FAILED from the requested error even when settlement is refused, another durable terminal wins, or ADD goes live. Exercise normal coordinator dispatch with authoritative target absence initially, then a failed second SERVICES query before ordinary terminal admission, followed by restored authority. Route all parallel failOperation-plus-manufactured-result arms in operation-workflow-dispatch-response-reconcile through the existing buildTerminalOperationDispatchResult. Keep retry, handoff, delivery ambiguity, and durable terminal ownership intact.

Independent review at b5a41f99d3f50297dc4510671d0c0603c3c0f807 found malformed or incomplete successful-looking gateway rows could mint authoritative ABSENT, and a contradictory ABSENT observation could grant terminal admission. The real gateway normalizes malformed nested rows to [] while setting rowSetComplete false. Extend current strict-operation-outcomes witnesses at the existing exact SERVICES observer boundary using production SQLite and gateway, and retain genuine empty, exact CREATING and foreign identity controls. Writable paths for this attempt are the existing assignment observation owner and witness. No changes to prior evidence or deadline.

Independent review also found priority REPLACE supersession passed a reason string after observing absence, allowing a target to obtain canonical CREATE admission and materialize at the last mutation ingress while the durable SENDING step stays unchanged. Use the existing exact replica-operation row CAS on completed_at and create_admission_state to serialize failure against ReplicaCreateAdmissionOwner.claim, and revalidate the supersession-specific lifecycle evidence at the last owner check. The handler publishes CREATING only under the winning operation-bound permit. Scope stays within the existing assigned priority dispatch, remove-safety, drain, terminal admission and observation files and the strict SQLite witness. Ordinary generic REPLACE failure retains its existing independent admission.

The two direct gateway fixture suites now provide the real gateway completeness field on genuine successes. The production read validates success, rowSetComplete, an array of at most one row for the exact service_id query and exact replica/partition/node on presence. Successful empty responses still use the owner’s corroboration step. Missing/malformed input, mismatched/ambiguous rows, and unknown status remain unavailable. The typed consumer rejects ABSENT with positive lifecycle fields and requires the authoritative source.

Managed RED 6f4d76861839d7a9b20d40b1cfc137b74db1011f on tv-dator recorded 605 assertions and all three reviewed failure mechanisms. Real gateway malformed nested/non-array/incomplete results granted unwanted ADD failure; contradictory ABSENT granted supersession; a real competing CREATE claim plus CREATING row at terminal ingress lost to unguarded FAILED. Output 6f4d76861839-mwphvfv2-3499130-tv-dator.log, SHA-256 f68aec583b5971e1343ae0f31b939d9491786316ee9064c83fc752a87a70aa47.

Carry the supersession subject and observation through local dispatch, both asynchronous remove-safety consumers, and both remote drain snapshot producers. Fresh durable SENDING/pre-sync identity and a new target observation must still match. Compare existing target lifecycle preconditions when present and permit complete, corroborated ABSENT without inventing a generation. The canonical terminal SQL predicate shares create_admission_state IS NULL with the CREATE owner and binds replica_id/target_node_id along with operation ID, current step and completed_at. The stronger mutation has no raw SQL alternate or zero-row reinsert. Existing terminal winners still resolve through durable replay before this admission.
